        "defectEvidenceAndRequiredChange": "No unit persists HvRun StartedUtc, ProcessId or the Claimed-to-Running transition. The run declares these fields (486), V-6 and ReadinessProbeVerdict use StartedUtc, Claim only starts the request (941), heartbeat only renews it (971), and RunReviewerProcess starts the OS process without a fenced run-start write (1395-1405). Define the owning command and its ordering/crash outcomes, with start/provenance tests.",

        "title": "Successful output close can discard an accepted cancellation",

          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:170",

        ],
        "defectEvidenceAndRequiredChange": "Cancel can commit CancelRequested after the last heartbeat and before successful process exit; CloseHvRunOutputCommand then overwrites it with Finalizing without checking cancellation (1016). This loses an accepted cancellation. R-28 also refuses repeat cancel of Canceled (170), while CancelHvRequestCommand returns 200 for it (787). Define consistent repeat semantics and the serialized cancel/close/finalize outcomes, with each interleaving tested.",
        "classification": "implementer edit"
      },

        "defectEvidenceAndRequiredChange": "RemoveHvEvidenceCommand writes RemovedBy and RemovalReason to output chunks (859, 873), but their entity has neither field (492). GetHvRequestQuery's lastOutput and StreamHvRunOutputQuery still decompress removed payloads without a removed-evidence outcome (753, 880-893), unlike FR-MCP-HVPIPE-019-AC004. Define the retained fields and post-removal behavior on every payload-reading surface, with named cases.",

        "defectEvidenceAndRequiredChange": "VI-05's asserted maximum of 14400 appends per run hour (2500) is false under R-12 and the byte-triggered flush (1395): multiple OutputFlushBytes batches can arrive within one interval. State a valid measurement workload and account for byte-triggered writes and audit overhead; do not call this an interval-imposed bound.",
        "classification": "implementer edit"
      },

        "title": "The artifact-worker repair has no contract for its existing requirements",

FR-MCP-HOSTILEREVIEW-002 AC4 prohibits raw artifact/prompt storage, unlike turn HV's complete brief log. No artifact queue adapter, units, identity mapping, retention boundary, or tests integrate these unchanged requirements. Define that separate-context contract and its H0 mocks/H3 production cases before approval, sharing only compatible execution primitives.",
